candidate_anchor_projection.eligible: case_transport_status=COMPLETE, every required anchor realization=ROLE_COMPATIBLE, and required binding slots=AVAILABLE
candidate_anchor_projection.forbidden: No fuzzy re-transport, no postfreeze erratum/join view, no name/comment/operator/truth inference.
candidate_anchor_projection.source: raw frozen blind transport receipt only

first_complete_output_rule.once_complete_58_observability_matrix_ex: No code, path-state rule, status mapping, eligibility rule, join logic, or checker logic may change before exact output archival, regardless of coverage or favorability.
first_complete_output_rule.pre_complete_crash_repair: Allowed only for implementation/plumbing defects before any complete 58 matrix exists; every repair must be classified, cannot use forbidden inputs, and cannot change this frozen protocol.

must_recompute: overlay node/edge content addressing and provenance
per-case observability status and final aggregate

opaque_58_execution.transport_incomplete_policy: Preserve as OBSERVABILITY_INCOMPLETE_TRANSPORT; never override using candidate graph evidence.

path_observability_extension.noninterference: Additive sidecar only; frozen observability_overlay.py and frozen A2 bytes are not modified.
state_semantics: Each path_state_id is content-addressed from predecessor state, structured control decision, and reaching-definition map.
IF forks separate states tagged by exact branch-bearing guard identity and parser-derived polarity.
Straight-line writes kill only within each path state.
Joins retain distinct mutually exclusive path states for witness use; they MUST NOT Cartesian-product a definition from one branch with control facts from another.
Unsupported material control makes the affected scope INCOMPLETE_FOR_MUST_PATH.
Raw line order is provenance only, never execution authority.

preimplementation_end_to_end_microqualif.rule: Every representable family is instantiated through the real frozen frontend -> base IR -> frozen A2O -> new path sidecar in Python, Go, and TypeScript/JavaScript. Unsupported constructs are expected fail-closed observations, never silently skipped.

purpose: Qualify whether frozen candidate bytes plus frozen mutation-blind transport can produce provenance-bearing, path-correlated D1/D2/D3 observability sufficient to execute the already-preregistered A3/A4 calculus. This protocol emits no A3/A4 semantic verdict.

qualification_outcomes.INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID_BEFORE_PREDICTION: Candidate hash/parser/base-IR/overlay/content-address authority cannot be validly produced.
qualification_outcomes.OBSERVABILITY_INCOMPLETE: Infrastructure is valid but one or more proof preconditions are unavailable or unproved.
qualification_outcomes.OBSERVABILITY_QUALIFIED_FOR_A3_A4_EXECUT: All applicable Stage-3 observability preconditions are complete and independently reproduced; this is not preservation evidence.

representation_rule.rule: Representation presence/survival may be observed, but absence cannot support A3_R4. Emit REPRESENTATION_CLOSURE_UNPROVEN unless a future separately preregistered closure mechanism is qualified.
